picks.excerpt: Users forgive a slow answer; what breaks trust is an AI product that is fast one day and slow the next without explanation. A founder-engineer on designing latency and variance communication into AI interfaces.
picks.rationale: Names a concrete, under-designed AI UX problem (latency variance, not latency) and gives designers something to put in the interface tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: 'Taste is what AI can't replace' has become designers' go-to defense as execution gets easier; this piece argues taste alone won't protect designers' jobs from AI.

picks.excerpt: How to design inputs for AI product-photo editing: separating the product image from the style reference so the model keeps the product intact while adopting the ad's look.
picks.rationale: A concrete input-design pattern (keep the product image and the style reference apart) for anyone making or designing AI product-photo tools.
